'''October 1999 Alpharetta tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Alpharetta, Georgia on 2 October 1999. It is known from Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d63">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-05-alpharetta-ga-1999-10-02d63/ alpharetta-ga-1999-10-02], DeckTech (Charlie "CommieBoy" Herren, 5 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-05-alpharetta-ga-1999-10-02d63/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 October 1999
* '''Site:''' Alpharetta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
